column1: # Provisional game profile (generated by scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py from the survey with dm/games/profile_guess.py, not checked by hand)
# FIFA 22 Legacy Edition, SDK 11; profile for game version 1.0.5.
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk0 (GLSLC)
# Keep the 5 GiB reservation; round the heap to 3 GiB and assign 1.5 GiB to alias.
# Loaded modules round to 104 MiB; the logged main-thread stack is 64 MiB.
# Include 4 MiB of system-resource usage so SDK program-size accounting cannot underflow.
# the NPDM declares 8 MB of system resource
# Device uses DM_PSO_MTL4=1; also include the pulling vertex libraries it needs.
# Material shaders choose combined handles from c2 slots 0-7.
# Raw varying-handle shaders remain rejected by the host.
# Host snapshot commands exceed FIFA's fixed 512 KiB hardware command budget;
# its out-of-memory callback deliberately faults instead of supplying a segment.
# ---- Application pool corrected from device evidence ----
# The measured 2980 MiB heap plus 104 MiB of modules cannot fit the old 2 GiB estimate.
# Restore the engine's standard Switch application pool (3285 MiB).
# heap check: 2026-11-08, corrected from two device logs; 3 GiB heap, standard pool, used-memory accounting; retest pending
